title: Earthquake Simulator Pro (open_quake_sim) — Japan earthquake, tsunami and EEW simulation
description:
Web-based research-oriented earthquake and tsunami simulation platform for Japan. Faithful Zhao et al. (2006) GMPE with frozen calibration tables and a three-family GMPE logic tree, 1D equivalent-linear site response (Thomson-Haskell + Darendeli curves, SHAKE-91 external benchmark), ensemble uncertainty fields with spatial correlation, kinematic finite-fault sources (Okada DC3D, von Karman slip spectra, segmented/listric geometry), a PSHA engine with conditional spectrum / UHS, hazard deaggregation and BPT time-dependent renewal, a conditional-spectrum broadband synthesis pipeline (SH production line; the P-SV completion arm was executed on a pre-registered quad-double array and retired with frozen negative reports), two-way AMR nonlinear shallow-water tsunami solver with optional Boussinesq dispersion, EEW detection rehearsal, and a real-time monitoring suite (JMA EEW / Kmoni / tsunami / 551 bulletins, live GSN waveforms via a miniSEED STEIM1/2 decoder). All validation results, including negative ones, are frozen in PHYSICS_BENCHMARKS.md and docs/SCIENTIFIC-REPORT.md; per-dataset provenance and licences in public/data-catalog.js.

v6.5 brings regional tsunami to full parity: the JMA-grade alert chain now runs on regional forecast-area registries (the active region’s own admin polygons snapped to its GEBCO 2025 bathymetry grid), so Chile / Italy / California ocean epicenters raise graded alerts with first-wave ETA countdowns, alert chimes and speech; a worker peak-cache fix repaired the physical-arrival path for standalone grids (verified live: Maule 13.4 m at 393 s). All three pilot regions bundle GEBCO 2025 bathymetry strips (Chile megathrust margin, Strait of Messina, California offshore incl. the southern Cascadia margin); Italy/Chile use real Vs30 from the assembled USGS global hybrid (Heath et al. 2020, Earthquake Spectra 36(3), doi:10.1177/8755293020911137). Honest boundaries: JMA-semantics thresholds (not SHOA/CAT/NOAA products), land-cell preset epicenters keep tsunami off, the 1906 San Francisco nearshore water-cell artifact is documented, not tuned.

Bundled derived datasets: J-SHIS Vs30 derived grid (J-SHIS terms), JIVSM derived bedrock/column grids (J-SHIS terms), KiK-net surface/borehole derived spectral-ratio statistics (NIED DOI 10.17598/NIED.0004, derived quantities only), GEBCO 2025 resample (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29), JMA observation data (気象庁, government open work).
notes: Trilingual UI (Japanese / English / Chinese; follows the browser language on first visit, switchable at the top of the sidebar). Core simulation targets Japan: JMA intensity scale, JMA tsunami forecast areas, the Japan station network and JMA-style EEW; the realtime monitoring suite tracks Japanese official feeds. A global pilot mode adds real FDSN station packages and a region registry (California / Italy / Chile) with per-package provenance and honest uncalibrated labeling; regional tsunami stays off where no bathymetry package is bundled. Source repository: https://github.com/Dongwu259/open_quake_sim (MIT). This record archives the tagged release; the research manifest (public/data-catalog.js) is the authoritative per-dataset provenance record.
